🔥 The fire settles. Jenny has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A crow that watches too long and blinks too little — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ivy mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Miguel says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking:

fightLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Ellis Schaefer. Electrician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Mother's Ring, Seed packet, Dispatcher's headset, Dog tags, Carpenter's square. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wrong. They move when you aren't looking. Yesterday there were seven. Tonight there are nine. They're getting closer.
You remember the Crude bow at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Work Gloves at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) 📺 SYSTEM: "FIELD EQUIPMENT ISSUED." A pamphlet flutters down from nowhere. Cheerful pictograms. One page chewed by something. "REVISION 5. The spring-pole method has been DEEMED SPORTING. The pole does the work. You do the waiting. Waiting is the hard part. We believe in you." (It's in your pack — read it.)
⚔️ Ivy killed the Lockpick with their party — 4 rounds, 37 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
"Half rations for three days, voted and held — or a hard hunt now, hungry, to fill the bins before it's choosing-who-eats."
🌧️ The storm rolls over Haven like a held breath let go — rain hammering the tarps, the wind testing every knot Nora tied. Inside, it's almost cozy. Almost.
Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
